label: Blesta provisioning connector
summary: Prepare an explicitly mapped Blesta billing integration for authorized hosting service requests.
core_boundary: Billing credentials cannot impersonate root, mutate arbitrary subscriptions or introduce alternate host execution paths. This is a design-only connector proposal. Essential hosting, current actor and tenant authorization, native service drivers and recovery remain in the free Core. No production interface, publisher trust, installation or effectful capability is established by this metadata.
acceptance: Qualify the selected Blesta instance and product-to-Core-plan mapping with explicit organization and tenant ownership.
Exercise duplicate provisioning requests, partial failure, retry and remote cancellation without creating duplicate hosting resources.
Keep local operator recovery available when billing is disabled and require a separate retained-data or purge decision.

Before implementation, qualify an explicitly selected provider/interface revision, supported compatibility matrix, immutable package provenance, dependency inventory and licensing model; no release is admitted by this proposal.

Enforce current Core actor, tenant and capability checks at each admitted request; keep credentials in scoped secret references, redact diagnostics and reject arbitrary destinations, shell commands or host/container sockets.

Demonstrate that disablement, removal, provider outage and commercial entitlement loss preserve essential Core access, hosted workloads, local audit and recovery; retain owned data unless a separately authorized purge is requested.
